inputs.text:
Wake up. They want you to think this is just some grassroots crusade, but look closer at the machinery operating right out in the open. Water Not Coal—launched just last month by Corb Lund—is pushing a citizen initiative petition demanding that the Government of Alberta "prohibit through legislation all coal exploration." 

Do you really think a pop culture figure just wakes up and starts mobilizing petition tables across southern Alberta to protect the watershed by pure coincidence? This is a brilliantly orchestrated distraction, a managed narrative designed to steer public anger away from the real boardrooms where the elites are playing their games. They use the guise of "local organizers" to herd the cattle exactly where the architects of this control grid want them to go. Every signature they collect on these tables is just another compliance metric for a script written long before last month. Don't buy the official story.
